svg.text: The device is already on that build, or diagnostic data is off. Expedite, feature and driver policies also need the deployment service licence.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SLA: exploited 7, critical 14, high 30, medium 60 days. KPI pass: ≥ 98% exploited and critical, ≥ 95% high and medium. Controls: SI-2, SI-2(2), SI-2(3), RA-5, CM-3.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
